findings_fixed: Resizing a plot rebuilt visible bubble labels before they participated in layout, collapsing the coordinate body. Reuse labels on resize and explicitly include refreshed labels before measuring.

regression_reproduction.counting: Includes QtTest init/cleanup; supplemental before/after checks, not added to the suite total.

qt_tests.counting: Includes data rows and QtTest init/cleanup. Three large export/cancellation cases were excluded from this small-data round.

scenarios: Two coordinate bubbles at (11,13) and (5,2); manually drag one bubble, zoom anchors offscreen and restore with Fit.
Collapse and expand the output area; both coordinate rows remain visible and retain their values.
Export PNG while bubbles are open; success notification changes plot size without hiding coordinate rows.
Inspect 2400 x 1600 PNG; chart and localized legend are present, interactive bubbles/markers are absent.
Clear plot and fill the selected empty slot; no extra subplot is created.
Export processed series and per-point audit as CSV; compare all 128 rows.
Close one bubble and clear the remaining bubbles; close the application normally.
native_desktop.timing_note: Native review and the 52-case suite used final application-code changes before the version/documentation update; final rebuilt binary is checked separately.

csv_checks.numeric_comparison: Exact parsed-double equality of input, processed output and audit values; mark-only mode preserves the input.

limits: No repeated large-data memory stress or Monte Carlo calibration.
No scientific algorithm, workflow schema or runtime dependency changes.
Native Windows/MSVC and macOS final builds and distribution packages remain unverified.
The analysis_tests single-function invocation is not counted: its first suite passed, but the multi-suite runner rejected that selector in other suites.

supplemental_tests.scope: Six embedded-help methods and the new bubble resize regression, plus each executable init/cleanup.
